about: run-suites.sh counts a suite that exits 0 having printed any line starting SKIP as skipped, never passed, and names it with that line; a failure exits 1, a root it cannot enter 2 (could not look), and a skip with no failure 3, so the two never share a code. The suites run without git's repository variables. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE run-suites.sh tests/test_run_suites.py tests/mutants/jpt-skip-is-not-a-pass-on-run-suites.json

mutants.name: only-the-last-line-decides
mutants.target: a SKIP printed before a later "3 passed": exit 3

mutants.name: skip-exits-0
edits:
echo "run-suites: exit 3, none failed, ${#skipped[@]} skipped"
  exit 3
mutants.target: a skip and no failure: exit 3

mutants.name: skip-exits-2-as-before
mutants.target: a skip and no failure: exit 3

mutants.name: skip-named-without-its-line
mutants.target: named with the SKIP line, not the last line

mutants.name: git-variables-kept
mutants.target: a Python suite does not see GIT_DIR
